name: arena-agent-mode-pro
description: Arena Agent Mode Pro — a Manifest V3 Chrome extension for transparent, safety-first Arena.ai Agent Mode assistance.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && npm run copy:assets && npm run verify:extension
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:assets && npm run verify:extension
scripts.watch: npm run clean && npm run copy:assets && webpack --mode development --watch
scripts.test:legacy: node --check arena-agent-mode-pro.user.js && node tests/smoke.js && node tests/regression-toolcall-loop.js && node tests/regression-pause-toggle.js
scripts.test: npm run test:extension && npm run test:legacy
